content.text: Let me test the Researcher Agent with an extremely complex, multi-dimensional query to find its limits:

input.query: Conduct a comprehensive interdisciplinary analysis spanning: (1) Quantum computing implications for AI consciousness, (2) Neuromorphic computing architectures for artificial general intelligence, (3) Information theory foundations of emergent intelligence, (4) Philosophy of mind perspectives on computational consciousness, (5) Cognitive science models of self-awareness, (6) Mathematical foundations of recursive self-improvement, (7) Evolutionary algorithms for autonomous goal formation, (8) Systems theory approaches to emergence and complexity, (9) Ethics of autonomous decision-making in complex scenarios, and (10) Integration frameworks for human-AI collaborative intelligence. For each area, provide theoretical foundations, current research frontiers, practical implications, and future research directions. Include cross-domain synthesis and novel theoretical frameworks.
